title: Unique ordinary-unit normalized derived scalar endpoint for a flat internal module
statement: Let Lambda and Lambda-prime be commutative condensed ring objects, a:Lambda -> Lambda-prime a ring map, X a scheme, and M an internal module over the pulled-back Lambda on X [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category]. Assume M is flat, meaning tensor with M is exact. Use the actual derived extension and exact restriction scalar adjunction [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-endpoints]. There exists a unique isomorphism from derivedScalars(a,X)(M[0]) to the single complex of the ordinary scalar extension of M, whose adjoint is the single image of the actual ordinary extension unit followed by the inverse of the restriction/single comparison. No flatness of a is assumed.

source.place: Paragraph (1), derived scalar reduction on the flat unit and Tate line; Stacks Tag 06YY

proof.text: A single complex on a flat module is K-flat. The transpose of the localized cochain extension unit is invertible for the scalar adjunction with exact restriction, by the K-flat representative theorem. Compose it with the localization of the ordinary single-complex comparison.

The ordinary single-unit square is the unit formula in degree zero and equality from a zero source in every other degree. Naturality of the localization factor and single-functor isomorphism carries it to the derived square. This identifies the preceding composite with the adjunction transpose of exactly the displayed ordinary-unit map, proving existence of the normalized isomorphism.
The adjunction Hom equivalence is injective, so any two homs with this same transpose agree. An isomorphism is determined by its hom, proving uniqueness.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonal_flat_scalar_endpoint_iso
    {Λ Λ' : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}}
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] [MonObj Λ'] [IsCommMonObj Λ']
    (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a] (X : Scheme.{u}) (M : Modules Λ X)
    (hM : ObjectProperty.flat M) :
    ∃! i : (derivedScalars a X).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ X) 0).obj M) ≅
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ' X) 0).obj
          ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap a X)).obj M),
      (Mod.derivedExtendMapDerivedCategoryAdjunction (coefficientMap a X)).homEquiv _ _
          i.hom =
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ X) 0).map
            (Mod.extendUnit (coefficientMap a X) M) ≫
          ((Mod.comap (coefficientMap a X)).mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).inv.app
            ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap a X)).obj M)
